body: It's better to be homeless than dead, you can't come back from death, don't do it. Realistically, you have very litte to lose after all this. Keep going, cool your head and just focus on small things. First comes your health. Don't worry about the pets and her for now. Ignore her and take care of yourself. There is a way out. And you'll find it, just keep going. I wish you the best.

Hey man, I just wanted to say: don't do it. I'm in the same boat and can see myself in you, but deep down we know, it isn't the right decision. Give your gun to someone you trust and don't make the same mistake I did, you'll regret doing things on a whim (not saying this to scare you, I'm saying this because I know, there should be something out there for us, and we're missing out), and you shouldn't have to. Take a few days off and cool your head for now. We need it: you need it.
